description: Foxit PDF Editor for ChatGPT helps you manage and transform PDFs seamlessly. Upload, delete, or compare documents; create shareable links; edit, reorder, rotate, split, or merge pages; convert files to and from various formats; and compress or linearize PDFs—all within ChatGPT. Build organized packets in seconds — ready for students, professionals, or anyone needing fast PDF solutions without leaving the chat.
